falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,620 (July 2024 all-time high) on any daily close within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom formation required a lower low after the July peak; reclaiming the pre-correction high breaks the structural similarity and suggests the 'bottom' already occurred or the pattern is negated

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies elevated volatility/uncertainty; sustained VIX sub-12 indicates complacency and risk-on conditions that are incompatible with a bottoming process, invalidating the defensive HOLD signal

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rapid rate collapse of this magnitude would signal recession panic or emergency Fed response, transforming the pattern from a growth scare bottom into a full cyclical downturn—making the 2024 August bottom analogy fail as the macro regime shifts
